question: The marked price of a chair was ₹19,200. The shopkeeper was offering it for a discount of 20%, but on further bargaining agreed to offer a successive discount and finally sold the chair for ₹13,824. What was the second discount offered by the shopkeeper?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Price after the first 20% discount = 80% of ₹19,200 = ₹15,360

Value of the second discount offered = ₹15,360 − ₹13,824 = ₹1,536

Second discount % = (1536 ÷ 15360) × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = ₹19,200

First Discount (D₁) = 20%

Final Selling Price (SP) = ₹13,824

**Formula Used:**

Discount % = (Discount Value ÷ Base Price) × 100

 
 
 

 
 

 
 ₹19,200
 Marked Price

 
 ₹15,360
 After 1st Discount

 
 ₹13,824

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 19200 × (100 − 20) ÷ 100

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 19200 × 0.8 = ₹15,360

⇒ Amount of second discount = Price after 1st discount − Final Selling Price

⇒ Amount of second discount = 15360 − 13824 = ₹1,536

⇒ Second discount % = (Amount of second discount ÷ Price after 1st discount) × 100

⇒ Second discount % = (1536 ÷ 15360) × 100

⇒ Second discount % = 1 ÷ 10 × 100 = 10%

**∴ The correct answer is 10%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

The single equivalent discount for two successive discounts of a% and b% can be directly calculated as: (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Marked Price (MP) is the maximum retail price set by the shopkeeper. Discounts are always calculated on the MP, whereas Profit or Loss is strictly calculated on the Cost Price (CP).

Direct Relationship

The ratio linking MP, CP, Profit%, and Discount% is given by: MP ÷ CP = (100 + Profit%) ÷ (100 − Discount%).
